identification_policy.claim_boundary: A transparent open reduced-order landing model. It is not a reconstruction of unpublished Yang ADAMS/Abaqus parameters.

footprint_radius_m.source: square support polygon circumradius from digitized inradius

generalized_contact_and_observation_para.source: least-squares fit to Y0 Figure 9 only
generalized_contact_and_observation_para.interpretation: The vertical contact law drives rigid-body dynamics. Separate constant ratios map that generalized response to published main-strut load and buffer stroke because the linkage geometry and auxiliary-strut load split are not published.

acceptance.reason: Pitch inertia and exact geometry are not published, so asymmetric cases cannot yet be strict validation cases.

known_limits: Small-angle two-degree-of-freedom rigid-body model, not a flexible multibody mechanism.
Footpads are massless unilateral contacts and horizontal friction is omitted.
Published main-strut load and buffer stroke are observation mappings from generalized vertical contact; they are not reconstructed linkage forces or coordinates.
Raster curves are baseline-corrected before identification; raw CSV files remain unchanged.
